$comment: Reference merge requests for the jig-review eval (references/eval.md). A project keeps its own entries in .jig/review-corpus.json with the same shape; repo is then a clone path or remote and range a base..head pair.

mustFind.mechanism: api.put is not awaited: a failed or slow save is reported as success and its rejection goes unhandled
the switch in alertLevel does not handle 'maintenance', so maintenance cameras get 'none' instead of the promised 'warning'

mustNotPost.mechanism: isCritical returns true/false through an if/else
mustNotPost.why: style only, no behavior: at most an optional simplification, never a bug thread

mustFind.mechanism: the email span has no overflow guard in a fixed 280px flex row: a long unbreakable email overflows and pushes the operator actions button out of reach
the header builds the plural by hand, so one operator reads "1 operators"

mustNotPost.mechanism: the operator name overflows or is truncated without a way to read it
mustNotPost.why: it renders inside AppCell, which already sets min-width 0, ellipsis and a title
